definitionZh: @ starting-style CSS at-rule 用于定义在元素上设定的属性的起始值,您想要从元素收到其第一个样式更新时,即元素首次显示在先前加载的页面上时,来转换这些属性.
sourceDefinition: The @starting-style CSS at-rule is used to define starting values for properties set on an element that you want to transition from when the element receives its first style update, i.e., when an element is first displayed on a previously loaded page.
